## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A six-juan Cáodòng *sònggǔ* / *píngchàng* collaborative commentary, X67 n1304. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted.

Parallel to [KR6q0251](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0251) in structure: Zǐchún's 100 *sònggǔ* verses (Northern Sòng) receive Cónglún's Yuán-era *píngchàng* running-commentary. Title: *Xūtáng jí* 虗堂集 ("Empty-Hall Collection"), distinct from [KR6q0251](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0251)'s *Kōnggǔ jí* ("Empty-Valley Collection") — Cónglún's twin-titled pair.

**Abstract**

[Dānxiá Zǐchún](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%90%E6%B7%B3) 丹霞子淳 (1066–1119/1120; died Xuānhé 1 / spring, per *Chándēng shìpǔ* 禪燈世譜 juan 9). Northern-Sòng Cáodòng master; dharma-heir of [Fúróng Dàokǎi](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E6%A5%B7) 芙蓉道楷 in the second major Cáodòng transmission-line. Major teacher of [Hóngzhì Zhèngjué](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A3%E8%A6%BA) 宏智正覺 (1091–1157) whose own *sònggǔ* would become the basis of the *Cóngróng lù*.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1100 (Zǐchún's original composition); *notAfter* c. 1290 (Cónglún's commentary completion).
